name: rapidforge
description: RapidForge — multi-agent local lead generation platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/worker"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/worker
